description: DAO-COLL on a writable copy: two writable Databases on one file in Workspaces(0). A QueryDefs held from db is read (Count, Item('QDel'), names). Through db2 a QueryDef QNew2 is created and QDel is deleted. The held collection is read again (Count, names, Item('QNew2'), Item('QDel')), then Refresh, then read again. A fresh QueryDefs from db is read last.
